g.text: 12 high-input partitions | 700 messages/s | recorded Active–end intervals
Dotted line: action requested at 60 s. Filled circles: confirmed activation; bars continue to evaluation end (600 s).
Keep 3 has no intervention: its open circle marks the comparison reference. Active–end can include backlog recovery.
Shading: Before (30–60 s) and Eval. end (570–600 s). Throughput and p99 use consecutive 30-second intervals.
P99 uses evaluation messages completed in each interval. Warm-up completions can contribute to throughput; drain is excluded.
